mentions.name: Jant
mentions.description: This open-source blogging platform serves single authors with a modern publishing UI in the spirit of Tumblr, natively supporting Note, Link, and Quote formats plus thread-style replies. It deploys to Cloudflare Workers and syncs with GitHub, producing a Hugo site that builds on its own. Recent work added multilingual support so bilingual authors can publish to each language's audience separately, and a Repost feature is being designed to share liked posts from other blogs along with the original URL.
mentions.audience: Bilingual authors — the common case being someone writing for both Chinese and English readers — so they can publish to each language's audience separately.
